Name: Rug Runners
Author: AylaGames
Description:
[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/vHxzJdh/description-1.png[/img][/url]
Ever wish for your custom or even vanilla farmhouse, you could have rugs that extend across your house! Well, that's what this mod does for you! I got tired of having long hallways and not having a rug to place in there! This mod aims to place rugs in long hallways, in your kitchen and doorways!

You [u]dont[/u] have to install Happy Home Designer, but it makes the mod 100% easier to use. 


[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/ctCLtf1/how-to-install.png[/img][/url]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url]: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture[/url]: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488
4. Unzip Rug Runner mod into Stardew Valley Mods folder in your files.


[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/DWw6Qks/how-to-use.png[/img][/url]
With the Happy Home Designer overlay opened, navigate to the rugs, click on the [b]bamboo mat[/b]. There will be 3 individual rugs that look the same, the left piece is the start of the rug, the middle piece is the middle of the rug and the right piece is the end of the rug.

After you place down the rug piece, hover your mouse over it and use the arrow buttons on your keyboard to move the rug pieces together.


[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/Zg7RmXL/other.png[/img]
[/url]There are currently ten colors, four of them have designs. 

I am planning on adding alternative textures to the bone rug as well, so you can have bigger rugs for the hallways.
